verdict.rationale: Letta documents an official CLI (Letta Code) with a dedicated docs section. It covers interactive slash commands, a default local mode needing no login, headless non-interactive mode for scripts, CI/CD and UNIX composition, one-shot --ephemeral runs, and subcommands such as `letta shared-memory create`. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Headless mode allows you to run Letta Code non-interactively, making it easy to integrate into scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or compose with other UNIX tools.
Use --ephemeral to run a one-shot task without creating, resuming, or persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS
This default local mode stores agent state on your machine and does not require a Letta login.
